narrative.summary: On 28 May 2026 in Astana, the members of the Supreme Eurasian Economic Council adopted a joint statement on the responsible development of AI within the Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU). The political statement, published by the Eurasian Economic Commission, recognises the digital sovereignty of member states and commits them to dialogue among states, business and experts, joint projects applying AI, exchange of experience on regulating AI use and avoiding barriers on the EAEU internal market.
narrative.review_notes: The Eurasian Economic Commission's website was checked in November 2026 in a single search pass; other EAEU acts and programmes that may address AI have not yet been reviewed.

instruments.summary: Joint statement by the members of the Supreme Eurasian Economic Council on responsible AI development within the Eurasian Economic Union. Recognising the unconditional digital sovereignty of EAEU member states and the principles of objectivity, non-discrimination and ethics, it commits members to intensify dialogue among states, business and experts, implement joint projects applying AI technologies, develop dialogue and exchange of experience on regulating AI use, and avoid barriers on the EAEU internal market. It also calls for jointly developing technological and production chains linked to AI.
instruments.current_status: Adopted in Astana on 28 May 2026 (date and place printed in the text published by the Eurasian Economic Commission). A political statement with no decision number, not an EAEU legal act.
